headline: LIL WAYNE CLEARED ROD WAVE'S 'EVERY GIRL' USE
body: Akademiks reports that Lil Wayne approved Rod Wave's use of 'Every Girl' in a new song, adding that music clearances can take months. Apple Music's current album notes describe 'Don't Look Down' as Rod Wave's seventh album and identify 'One More Time' as a Selena interpolation. Together, the reporting places the approved use within Rod Wave's current album rollout.
